Subject: Artifacts required to complete Azure listing: SOC 2 attestation + penetration test letter

Hi Lindsey / Raj,

Thanks for the call this morning — excited to push the Azure Marketplace listing across the finish line. To satisfy the marketplace security gate and the co-sell paperwork, we need:

- A current SOC 2 Type II report (latest 12-month window) or an attestation letter we can reference in the listing page.
- A short penetration-test letter from a third-party vendor confirming scope (network + application) and the date of testing.
- Confirmation of DPA terms or a signed DPA document (some purchasers will request a copy).

If you can share the SOC 2 PDF and the pen-test letter as attachments, we’ll ingest them into the secure evidence bucket and link them to the marketplace submission. For any sensitive documents you prefer not to email, we have a secure upload — see link below.

Secure upload: https://app.redwood.example/secure-upload/HSP-4982

Our timeline: we want to submit artifacts to the Azure catalog reviewers by 2026-07-22 to meet the co-sell kickoff on 2026-07-28. Can you confirm if you can deliver by EOD 2026-07-20?

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the DocuSign DPA routing once we have the PDFs.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Head of Cloud Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference
[email signature]

Appreciate the clear list. Attaching the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted for customer data) and our pen-test confirmation letter. We redacted a small appendix of customer identifiers but left auditor opinion and control scope intact.

Attachments:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (pdf, 4.2MB)
- ThirdParty_PenTest_Letter_ACME_2026.pdf (pdf, 1.1MB)

About the DPA: we recently made an update to section 4 (data retention) and the legal team prefers Docusign for signatures. If you can route the DPA via DocuSign, I’ll approve the final page. I copied Raj from procurement to coordinate PO/contract flows for co-sell.

Short answers: we can deliver the signed pages via DocuSign by 2026-07-20 and have provided the artifacts as attachments. Please confirm receipt.

Thanks,
